purpose: Canonical registry connecting species-resolved evidence assets to public master foods without collapsing taxonomic or tortoise-applicability scope.
rules: A linked evidence asset is supporting detail, not an automatic feeding-verdict upgrade.
Exact T. g. ibera genus-level observations remain genus-level even when related Testudo evidence resolves an exact plant species.
Related Testudo exact-species records must not be relabeled as exact T. g. ibera evidence.
Wild occurrence or preference must not be converted into captive percentages, weekly frequency, daily feeding, staple status, unlimited feeding, or nutritional completeness.
Public evidence_detail should expose the strongest applicable evidence and the taxonomic/applicability limitation together.

links.exact_ibera_gap: No exact T. g. ibera Plantago species record verified in the species-resolution pass.
links.public_detail_rule: Show related T. g. graeca P. amplexicaulis and related Testudo P. lanceolata as supporting evidence only; do not imply genus-wide interchangeability.

links.exact_species_gap: Exact-Ibera sources report Taraxacum/Taraxacum sp., not T. officinale.
links.public_detail_rule: Lead with repeated exact-Ibera genus evidence; show T. officinale records from related Testudo only as species-resolved context.
Keep exact-Ibera Sonchus evidence separate from S. oleraceus records in related Testudo populations.
Do not assign T. campestre or T. repens records from related Testudo to T. g. ibera.

links.exact_species_gap: The direct Ibera observations are Medicago/Medicago sp.; they do not establish M. sativa as the consumed species.
links.public_detail_rule: For the M. sativa master, explicitly distinguish direct Ibera genus context from exact M. sativa evidence in related Testudo; no automatic verdict upgrade.

qa_requirements.no_orphan_asset: Every species-resolved evidence asset listed here must map to an existing canonical food_id.
qa_requirements.no_missing_asset: Every asset path listed here must exist.
qa_requirements.public_traceability: Public detail generation should be able to expose asset path/source records and limitations for these foods.
qa_requirements.verdict_independence: Linkage alone must not mutate feeding_level, diet_role, or evidence_grade.
